text:
vivian: Brainstorm: one-week PLG sprint to test 'progressive credits' vs flat credits + webinar push. Three arms: (1) flat 50 credits up front + 1 prompt template, (2) progressive unlock: 20 credits at signup, +30 after first_success + bonus 30 after 3 successful calls, (3) webinar-first: reserve office hours + 80 credits delivered only if attendee completes a post-webinar challenge. Primary metric: percent reaching 3rd success within 7 days. Secondary: webinar attendance lift, tokens/day. Who can own routing and gating?

sam: i can wire routing. prefer assignment at signup persisted. for progressive unlock we need events: first_success, third_success. gating: only company emails and non-enterprise trial accounts.

aditi: analytics: capture experiment_id, arm, unlock_events timestamps, webinar_attended, challenge_completed boolean, and total_tokens_week1. i'll run time-to-event analysis.

growth-bot: experiment created: id prog-credits-2026-06. assignment rule: randomized on signup, saved to user.experiments.prog_credits. grant flow supports staged grants for arm 'progressive'. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/prog-credits-2026-06

marco: UX note: for progressive unlock show a small progress pill in product: "20/80 credits unlocked" and CTA to "Try sample prompt". reduces surprise.

sam: ops constraints: global spend cap $4k, per-user cap 100 credits, progressive unlock expire after 14 days. will throttle grants to avoid farming. deliver credits via grant lambda. snippet for ops: ```json
{"experiment_id":"prog-credits-2026-06","arm":"progressive","stages":[{"credits":20,"trigger":"signup"},{"credits":30,"trigger":"first_success"},{"credits":30,"trigger":"third_success"}],"cap_per_user":100}
```

aditi: slightly worried about noise from folks who sign up just for webinar. we'll stratify by referral_source and run attendee vs non-attendee within arms. also include a control set of 200 users with no credits for baseline.

growth-bot: ramp plan: start with 300 randomized users Mon 09:00 UTC, monitor spend and grant rates. alert to #marketing-ops if spend > $600 in first 24h.

olivia: creative + emails: draft 3 copy variants emphasizing "level up credits as you use" for progressive arm, and "earn credits by attending" for webinar arm. social teaser + webinar signup page with challenge details. ETA Thu morning.

vivian: nice. final checklist: creative Thu EOD, infra + routing Fri noon, analytics tags live before launch. report back in-thread when gated events emit. launch Monday AM if all green. thanks team :rocket:
